principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for both calculating the area and generating output, which constitutes multiple responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of output generation into another class, such as an OutputFormatter, which can format and display the result of the calculations.

principle_violations.reason: The current implementation of the AreaCalculator class requires modifications to add new shape types, which violates the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement an interface for shapes that provides a method to calculate the area. Each shape would implement this interface, allowing AreaCalculator to handle the area calculation without requiring changes when new shapes are introduced.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class depends on a List of Object types which forces it to check types and perform casting, indicating a violation of the interface segregation principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define an interface for shapes (e.g., Shape) that includes an area calculation method and use a List of Shape types instead of a List of Object types.

overall_feedback: 3 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
